title: A user without Reports access still cannot open Sales By Representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: A colleague whose role has no access to reports tries to open Sales By Representative.
  • You are signed in as {User-B}, whose role does not have "Reports — Page Access", at {Location-A}.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR No Reports; {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: any page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look for Reports > Sales By Representative.
  2. Open the Sales By Representative report's address directly in the browser.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report is not offered.
  • Step 2: the report does not open for {User-B}; neither the screen nor its exports are available.
